title: Automation Templates: 6 Platforms Compared (2026)
summary: Automation templates vary in price and library breadth across six platforms. Compare their pricing to match your workflow needs.
body_markdown:
## FAQ on automation templates


These are the questions that come up once a template meets real accounts and real data.


### What is an automation template?


An automation template's a prebuilt workflow, with a trigger, the steps after it, and the apps connected, that you copy into your own workspace instead of building from scratch.


The logic is already written. You supply the logins and the details that are specific to you, such as which channel or which spreadsheet.


### Are automation templates free?


Usually the template itself costs nothing, but running it can. Most platforms let you import a template on any plan, and the bill arrives through how many tasks or runs it consumes.


If you're weighing a free template, check the pricing of the plan you'd be on, because one that fires on every incoming email is a different cost from one that runs once a day.


### Can I edit a template after importing it?


Yes. Once imported, the workflow's a copy that belongs to you, and you can change any step, swap an app, or delete a branch without touching the original.


The card lands on the canvas as a finished flow. The work's in the one connector block you adjust by hand, with a permissions checklist beside it showing what that block can read and write.


When you edit an imported template, most of the changes happen at the connectors, and each one's also a permissions decision. After you adjust a block, run it once on a test record and see whether it did what you meant, not what you typed.


### Do templates work with any app?


No. A template works with the apps it was built around.


Some platforms can swap one app for a similar one only when both have a connector in that platform. If your tool has no connector, you're rebuilding that step by hand or going through a generic web request step.


### Is it safe to connect company accounts to a template?


It's as safe as the permissions you grant. Read what each connection asks for before approving it, give it the narrowest access that still works, and prefer a dedicated service account over a personal login.


Then confirm who in your company is allowed to authorize connections at all.
